t2.thesis: KVYO enters earnings with a large run-up, a high implied move and a recent history of sharp post-earnings sell-offs, which offsets the typical positive drift and leaves the outcome close to a coin flip.
reasons: Stock is up about 30% in 1m and 7% in 5d after the Braze/Salesforce takeover read-through, so a lot of good news is already priced in.
The last two prints saw -15% and -22% reactions despite EPS in line or beat, which suggests that the bar is high on guidance.
Implied move of about 19% is large, and ATM IV is 1.5x realized vol, so premium is rich with no directional tilt (call-put IV spread near zero).
Q3 guide of 21.5-22.5% growth is a deceleration from 26%, but the company has repeatedly raised guidance, and short interest of 16% adds squeeze potential on a beat.
Goldman downgrade on Oct 16 and a 90-day EPS revision of -17% are modest negatives.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and the full-year raise relative to elevated expectations after the sector rerating.
